final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_price_per_day, avg_price_per_day / (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) FROM r) AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM r ORDER BY rating
